=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:882-896 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The remerge-scope guard grants the `merge_resolve_audit` delta carry when every remerge-diff file is in `from..head`. It never checks that those files are also in the audit's explicit range `merge-base(default branch, head)..head`, and scripts/security_audit.sh:914-949 intersects that range with `from..head`. A file whose conflict was resolved by keeping the base parent's content (head:F == base:F, head:F != from:F) is granted the carry and then dropped from the audit.
  WHY: All three flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high); confidence was 5 from gemini and gpt-6-luna and 4 from glm. The security pass can report a clean delta and record the head clean without auditing the file whose content the resolution decided. Two reviewers disagree: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected the finding, arguing that such an F is also missing from the full audit's merge-base..head list, so the delta audit drops nothing the full audit would cover. minimax_minimax-m3 deliberately did not re-raise it, citing the prior editor's reasoning that this content is upstream and already audited there.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:around lines 882-895 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The remerge-scope guard grants `merge_resolve_audit` based only on whether the resolution delta (from..head) is covered. It ignores the security audit's actual scope (merge-base..head).
  WHY: A resolution that keeps the head's version and reverts a base-branch change leaves the file unchanged between the base tip and the resolution commit, so the file is missing from merge-base..head. The delta audit then skips a file that is part of the conflict resolution.

  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: append "plus, in a shallow checkout (deterministic-skip job), one `git fetch --unshallow` of the head branch in the security-pass carry." (estimated lines changed: 1).

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:882-896 (with scripts/security_audit.sh:914-949 and scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:1402) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The remerge-scope guard (comm -23 at 882-886) grants the `merge_resolve_audit` carry when the remerge files are within `from..head`. It never checks the explicit range `merge-base(default branch, head)..head`, and security_audit.sh:941 (`grep -Fxf`) intersects with that range, so a take-base resolution file (head:F == base:F) is dropped from the audit.
  WHY: The head is marked `merge_resolve_carry` and recorded clean without its remerge diff being audited. This contradicts issue scope item 5 and the fail-closed contract in the comments at 868-871 and 1378-1382; it mirrors the take-ours case fixed earlier. Suggested fix: also compute `git diff --no-ext-diff --name-only "${head_sha}^2..${head_sha}"`, require a second `comm -23` check, and fall back to `scope_uncovered` when it fails.
- README.md:the `MERGE_RESOLVE_DELTA_REVIEW_ENABLED` row, "Costs, per resolution head" sentence | HARDENING_SUGGESTION | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The cost note omits the new shallow-checkout `git fetch --unshallow` of the head branch that the security-pass carry can now run (deterministic-skip job, fetch-depth 1).
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: append "plus, in a shallow checkout (deterministic-skip job), one `git fetch --unshallow` of the head branch in the security-pass carry" (estimated lines changed: 1).
